Oneliner

Demonstrate propulsion system, relative navigation and high performance downlink.
Description

PETRUS, an innovative pulsed electric propulsion system, will give SOURCE-2 greater maneuverability in orbit. The propulsion system originates from the IRS and will be further developed by KSat and integrated into SOURCE-2. 

The IRS also supports the DETECT experiment, which tests autonomous object detection for relative navigation in low Earth orbit. This is a step for future on-orbit servicing missions and concepts for combating space debris. 

In addition, we are working together with SeeSat eV on a high-performance direct downlink system. A big thank you goes to the Ministry of Science, Research and the Arts Baden-Württemberg, which is funding SOURCE-2 as part of the state strategy for aerospace THE aerospace LÄND .
